reviews.comment: Exams are extremely difficult & require in-depth understanding of material. The group essays are easy but graded strictly. However, Prof. Fieldhouse is a really kind and sweet person. He was always willing to help me during office hours. Learned a lot in this class because he has interesting, up-to-date lectures; his efforts never went unnoticed:)
Amazing! Professor Fieldhouse genuinely cares about his students and wants to see them succeed.

Professor Fieldhouse is one of my favorite professors at TAMU. His tests are quite difficult; however, he gives you ample practice tests, quizzes, and resources to prepare for them. If you want to truly understand money/capital markets, you should go with Fieldhouse. He is extremely intelligent and provokes thoughtful discussion in his lectures.

Avoid at all cost if possible. Smart guy cool outside of class but man. Hardest grader ever on the group essays. Exams are about 60% of your grade even if you drop the midterm. Hardest finance exams I have ever taken. The lectures do not match the level of understanding needed for exams. No solutions for practice exams. Talks interest rates a lot.

He is extremely knowledgeable in the field of finance and has great, high-quality lectures. His tests are difficult, but he gives us many practice tests for preparation. He uses AI to grade his SREs, but I have not found it to be unreasonable.

Professor Fieldhouse is a great guy who cares about his students and is very well accomplished. He constantly applied the course curriculum to current research papers and topics within financial markets which I found quite helpful. I'd take him if you can!

He is a super nice and intelligent guy. Exams are hard, but there is a large curve. Lectures are boring but he posts all notes on canvas. Content itself is boring and there's not much he can do to make it exciting. I'd recommend him if he's available. Not an impossible class

Professor Fieldhouse is a great guy. He does his best to engage the class but most of us are not on the same interest and intelligence level as him. Exams are very short and difficult, but there is a large curve. Other assignments add a boost to overall grade. He is a very interesting person, recommend asking him questions outside of class.

While Fieldhouse is knowledgeable, exams for this class were extremely difficult - averages would often be failing and he had to curve up each time. Do not slack on the midterm and use the option of making the final 60% of your grade- sounds enticing initially but even with an immense amount of studying it's hard to get a good grade on the final.

Not a bad teacher but exams are made for students to fail. The midterm average was 60 and the final average was a 55.6 which in my opinion is absurd, especially since they are each worth 30% of your grade. He added a 15 point curve to each but that hardly helps when the average for the final is a 55.6. Very attainable B essentially an impossible A.

Professor Fieldhouse is a very smart guy. His lectures are boring not because of him but because of the content he covers. He provides all the material you need to get an A (ex. Former Exams, Study Guides, etc). The class also has group essays which are very easy too.
